title: Braving the Demon Clan
summary: Jin Chi demands Ye Fan's Black-Yellow Mother Qi and starts a countdown, holding back only out of face for Qing Yi, whose guest Ye Fan is. The beaten Ku Zhu rises again, now faster and stronger than a Dao Palace cultivator, secretly driven by a hidden power using the Heavenly Peng body technique on behalf of the 'young master'. Ye Fan still wins the bout. Jin Chi backs off only after the Princess's side reminds him that Ye Fan is Qing Yi's guest and the Princess's old friend. At her residence Yan Ruyu scolds Ye Fan for using her name. She says she wants the Demon Clan to have a new Demon King, won't let outsiders meddle over Pang Bo, and together with Qin Yao blocks him from leaving. Qing Yi's envoy then invites him to Qing Yi's 300th birthday banquet, where demon elders recall the Azure Emperor's lost glory. At the banquet Jin Chi offers a treasure for the Mother Qi and the elders back him, but someone objects that Ye Fan won the contest for Qin Yao and so counts as one of them. Ye Fan goads Jin Chi into fighting at the same level, and Jin Chi agrees to suppress himself to Dao Palace without his sacred weapon.

changes: The old summary said Ye Fan kills the possessed Ku Zhu. The subtitles only declare Ye Fan the winner (7:30), and Ku Zhu's death isn't stated.
Added the Princess's residence scene, Qing Yi's 300th birthday banquet, and how Jin Chi's suppressed duel was set up.
flags: Whoever controls Ku Zhu (6:46 'Tuan Muda. Tubuh anak ini lemah...') isn't named. It's someone serving Jin Chi.
It isn't said who raises the objection at 16:02 ('Saya menentang!'). It's someone from the Princess's side.
Jin Chi goes by both 'Raja Elang Muda' (Young Eagle/Peng King) and 'Saudara Peng'. The info card at 18:26 spells Four Poles as 'Empat Fole'.
'Raja Kongque' (Peacock King) is mentioned at the banquet (11:41) but not shown.
